description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The D. E. Shaw Group is a quantitative investment firm seeking a Software Developer to join its Futures team. The role focuses on developing and supporting low-latency, algorithmic trading systems, statistical models, research infrastructure, simulations, forecasting tools, and market-data analysis.
Low-latency futures trading software developer building simulation, forecasting infrastructure, and quantitative research tools

Responsibilities:
• Maintain, develop, and support low-latency trading systems, including improving reliability and performance, addressing operational issues, and conferring with technical support teams
• Support and automate statistical models for low-latency trading systems
• Develop on-premise and cloud computing infrastructure to support large-scale research workflows
• Develop tools and infrastructure for Futures historical simulations, including testing and analysis
• Develop infrastructure to generate predictors within Futures forecasting models
• Analyze historical market data to model exchange trading behavior and data quality, supporting quantitative researchers using these models in their research
• Work with existing technical infrastructure, relevant quantitative models, and contemporary academic research
• Communicate with management about project and team priorities, helping propose new projects and set priorities
• Interview and recruit candidates

Requirements:
• A bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field of study
• One year of experience in the following: programming in Python; programming in Java; Object-Oriented Programming; functional programming; software design patterns; software debugging in the UNIX environment; operating systems; low latency trading systems; and, systematic or quantitative trading
